isRebuilding.description: Whether the Search Index is currently rebuilding.

isStale.description: Whether changes are waiting to be incorporated by a Search Index rebuild.

lastRebuildStarted.description: When the most recent rebuild started, or null when unavailable.

lastRebuildCompleted.description: When the most recent completed rebuild finished, or null when unavailable.

lastRebuildOpportunity.description: When the Search Index most recently had an opportunity to rebuild, whether or not a rebuild was required.

lastRebuildDuration.description: Human-readable duration of the most recent rebuild.

staleDuration.description: Human-readable duration for which the Search Index has currently been stale.

lastStaleDuration.description: Human-readable duration of the most recently completed stale period.

description: Current rebuild and stale-data state for a Search Index.
